The '''IA-82 Artillery Droid''' was a model of six-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The IA-82 generated massive ion blasts from its forward cannon, leaving ion fields in the wake of the blast. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] arms dealer [[Olok]] the Shadow sold IA-82 Artillery Droids in his auction on [[Darvannis]].

==Behind the scenes==
IA-82 Artillery Droids appear as one of the four types of droid enemies in the Olok the Shadow boss encounter in the Operation "Scum and Villainy," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']].<ref name="TOR" />
